SELECT SUM(CAL.COUNT) AS COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(CU.REG_DATE) FROM CBCI_USER CU WHERE USER_TYPE = 2 AND LEFT(CU.REG_DATE,10) < #{fromDate}) AS TOTAL
(SELECT COUNT(CU.USER_NO) FROM CBCI_USER CU WHERE USER_TYPE = 2 AND LEFT(CU.REG_DATE,10) < #{fromDate} AND CU.USER_NO IN (SELECT MUI.USER_NO FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI WHERE MUI.DIVISION IN (SELECT MP.DIVISION FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.FIRM_NO REGEXP (#{PARTNER}) AND MP.PRODUCT_TYPE REGEXP (#{PRODUCT_TYPE})))) AS TOTAL
FROM(
SELECT
FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE,
DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS REG_DATE, WEEK(FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE,5) - WEEK(DATE_SUB(FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE,INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE)-1 DAY),5) + 1 AS MONTHOFWEEK, LEFT(FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE,7) AS YEARMONTH,
FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE AS YEARMONTH,
IFNULL(COUNT(FIRST_CAL.USER_NO),0) AS COUNT FROM ( SELECT LEFT(REG_DATE ,10) AS REG_DATE, CU.USER_NO FROM CBCI_USER CU WHERE CU.REG_DATE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate}
AND CU.USER_NO IN (SELECT MUI.USER_NO FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI WHERE MUI.DIVISION IN (SELECT MP.DIVISION FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.FIRM_NO REGEXP (#{PARTNER}) AND MP.PRODUCT_TYPE REGEXP (#{PRODUCT_TYPE})))
UNION ALL SELECT A.DATE AS REG_DATE, null AS USER_NO FROM ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL (A.A + (10 * B.A) + (100 * C.A)) DAY AS DATE FROM (SELECT 0 AS A UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) AS A CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS A UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) AS B CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS A UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) AS C ) A WHERE A.DATE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ) FIRST_CAL
GROUP BY FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE
GROUP BY YEARWEEK(FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE)
GROUP BY LEFT(FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE,7)
ORDER BY FIRST_CAL.REG_DATE
)CAL

SELECT

AND CU.USER_NO IN (SELECT MUI.USER_NO FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI WHERE MUI.DIVISION IN (SELECT MP.DIVISION FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.FIRM_NO REGEXP (#{PARTNER}) AND MP.PRODUCT_TYPE REGEXP (#{PRODUCT_TYPE})))

SELECT
FOUND_ROWS() AS TOTAL_COUNT, CONVERT(IFNULL(SUM(CAL.QUANTITY), 0), SIGNED INTEGER) AS QUANTITY, CONVERT(IFNULL(SUM(CAL.ORDER_PRICE), 0), SIGNED INTEGER) AS ORDER_PRICE, CAL.SHOP_TYPE
CAL.PAID_AT,
DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CAL.PAID_AT, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(CAL.PAID_AT) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS ORDERED_AT, WEEK(CAL.PAID_AT,5) - WEEK(DATE_SUB(CAL.PAID_AT,INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(CAL.PAID_AT)-1 DAY),5) + 1 AS MONTHOFWEEK, LEFT(CAL.PAID_AT,7) AS YEARMONTH,
LEFT(CAL.PAID_AT,7) AS YEARMONTH,
CONVERT(IFNULL(SUM(CAL.QUANTITY), 0), SIGNED INTEGER) AS QUANTITY, CONVERT(IFNULL(SUM(CAL.ORDER_PRICE), 0), SIGNED INTEGER) AS ORDER_PRICE
CONVERT(SUM(CAL.QUANTITY) / ${COUNT}, SIGNED INTEGER) AS QUANTITY, CONVERT(SUM(CAL.ORDER_PRICE) / ${COUNT}, SIGNED INTEGER) AS ORDER_PRICE
FROM(
SELECT 1 AS SHOP_TYPE, '인터파크' AS SHOP, DATE_FORMAT(PAID_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAID_AT, QUANTITY, ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_INTERPARK_SALES WHERE PAID_AT >= STR_TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND PAID_AT < STR_TO_DATE(DATE_ADD(#{toDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')
AND SHOP_ID IN (SELECT CA.SHOP_ID FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA WHERE CA.SHOP_TYPE = '1' AND CA.USER_NO IN ( SELECT MUI.USER_NO FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI WHERE MUI.DIVISION IN ( SELECT MP.DIVISION FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.FIRM_NO REGEXP (#{PARTNER}) AND MP.PRODUCT_TYPE REGEXP (#{PRODUCT_TYPE}))))
UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS SHOP_TYPE, '지마켓' AS SHOP, DATE_FORMAT(PAID_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAID_AT, QUANTITY, ORDER_PRICE-(PURCHASE_COUPON_PRICE+SELLER_DISCOUNT_PRICE+SMILE_CASH) AS ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_GMARKET_SALES WHERE PAID_AT >= #{fromDate} AND PAID_AT < DATE_ADD(#{toDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND SHOP_ID IN (SELECT CA.SHOP_ID FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA WHERE CA.SHOP_TYPE = '2' AND CA.USER_NO IN ( SELECT MUI.USER_NO FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI WHERE MUI.DIVISION IN ( SELECT MP.DIVISION FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.FIRM_NO REGEXP (#{PARTNER}) AND MP.PRODUCT_TYPE REGEXP (#{PRODUCT_TYPE}))))
UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS SHOP_TYPE, '옥션' AS SHOP, DATE_FORMAT(PAID_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAID_AT, QUANTITY, ORDER_PRICE-(SELLER_DISCOUNT_PRICE+EXCELLENT_MEM_DISCOUNT+SMILE_CASH) AS ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_AUCTION_SALES WHERE PAID_AT >= STR_TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND PAID_AT < STR_TO_DATE(DATE_ADD(#{toDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d')
AND SHOP_ID IN (SELECT CA.SHOP_ID FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA WHERE CA.SHOP_TYPE = '3' AND CA.USER_NO IN ( SELECT MUI.USER_NO FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI WHERE MUI.DIVISION IN ( SELECT MP.DIVISION FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.FIRM_NO REGEXP (#{PARTNER}) AND MP.PRODUCT_TYPE REGEXP (#{PRODUCT_TYPE}))))
UNION ALL SELECT -- 선결제 배송비 합치기 불가 4 AS SHOP_TYPE, '11번가' AS SHOP, DATE_FORMAT(결제완료일, '%Y-%m-%d') AS ORDERED_AT, 수량 AS QUANTITY, 판매금액합계-(할인쿠폰이용료+복수구매할인비용+판매자부담카드추가할인+공제_스토어묶음쿠폰할인+후불광고비) AS ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_11ST_SALEACCNT WHERE 결제완료일 >= DATE_FORMAT(#{fromDate},'%Y/%m/%d') AND 결제완료일 < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(#{toDate},INTERVAL 1 DAY),'%Y/%m/%d') AND 주문상태 NOT IN ('구매확정후주문취소','반품완료','취소처리중','클레임진행중') AND 선결제배송비 = 0
AND SHOP_ID IN (SELECT CA.SHOP_ID FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA WHERE CA.SHOP_TYPE = '4' AND CA.USER_NO IN ( SELECT MUI.USER_NO FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI WHERE MUI.DIVISION IN ( SELECT MP.DIVISION FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.FIRM_NO REGEXP (#{PARTNER}) AND MP.PRODUCT_TYPE REGEXP (#{PRODUCT_TYPE}))))
UNION ALL SELECT 11 AS SHOP_TYPE, '쿠팡' AS SHOP, DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS PAID_AT, shipping_count AS QUANTITY, order_price AS ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_COUPANG_SALES WHERE paid_at >= #{fromDate} AND paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{toDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND status IN ('ACCEPT','DELIVERING','DEPARTURE','FINAL_DELIVERY','INSTRUCT','NONE_TRACKING') AND sale_type IN ('', 'SALE')
AND SHOP_ID IN (SELECT CA.SHOP_ID FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA WHERE CA.SHOP_TYPE = '11' AND CA.USER_NO IN ( SELECT MUI.USER_NO FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI WHERE MUI.DIVISION IN ( SELECT MP.DIVISION FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.FIRM_NO REGEXP (#{PARTNER}) AND MP.PRODUCT_TYPE REGEXP (#{PRODUCT_TYPE}))))
UNION ALL SELECT 14 AS SHOP_TYPE, '네이버' AS SHOP, IF(PAID_AT IS NULL, '-', DATE_FORMAT(PAID_AT, '%Y-%m-%d')) AS PAID_AT, IFNULL(QUANTITY, 0) AS QUANTITY, ORDER_PRICE FROM CBCI_NAVER_SALES WHERE PAID_AT >= STR_TO_DATE(#{fromDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND PAID_AT < STR_TO_DATE(DATE_ADD(#{toDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AND ORDER_STATUS IN ('발송대기', '배송중', '배송완료', '빠른정산', '구매확정', '정산', '일반정산')
AND SHOP_ID IN (SELECT CA.SHOP_ID FROM CBCI_ACCOUNT CA WHERE CA.SHOP_TYPE = '14' AND CA.USER_NO IN ( SELECT MUI.USER_NO FROM MONEYBANK_USER_INFO MUI WHERE MUI.DIVISION IN ( SELECT MP.DIVISION FROM MONEYBANK_PRODUCT MP WHERE MP.FIRM_NO REGEXP (#{PARTNER}) AND MP.PRODUCT_TYPE REGEXP (#{PRODUCT_TYPE}))))
UNION ALL SELECT '0' AS SHOP_TYPE, '0' AS SHOP, A.DATE AS ORDERED_AT, '0' AS QUANTITY, '0' AS ORDER_PRICE FROM ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL (A.A + (10 * B.A) + (100 * C.A)) DAY AS DATE FROM (SELECT 0 AS A UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) AS A CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS A UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) AS B CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS A UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) AS C ) A WHERE A.DATE BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} )CAL
GROUP BY CAL.PAID_AT
GROUP BY YEARWEEK(CAL.PAID_AT)
GROUP BY LEFT(CAL.PAID_AT,7)
GROUP BY CAL.SHOP_TYPE

A.DATE,
DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(A.DATE, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(A.DATE) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS DATE, WEEK(A.DATE,5) - WEEK(DATE_SUB(A.DATE,INTERVAL DAYOFMONTH(A.DATE)-1 DAY),5) + 1 AS MONTHOFWEEK, LEFT(A.DATE,7) AS YEARMONTH,

GROUP BY A.DATE
GROUP BY YEARWEEK(A.DATE)
GROUP BY LEFT(A.DATE,7)
ORDER BY A.DATE
